title: NCERT rolls out 20-hour AI, computational thinking module for classes 9-12
description: The National Council of Educational Research and Training has introduced a module on computational thinking and artificial intelligence for students. This 20-hour course is designed for students in grades 9 to 12 with no prior AI knowledge. It emphasizes critical thinking, creativity, and responsible technology use while covering ethical AI applications. The module includes activity-based learning to enhance understanding of AI concepts, applications, and limitations.
